# netactuate_cloud_plan_id (Data Source)

Looks up a cloud plan ID by plan name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_plan_id" "example" {
  plan_name = "vc-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan_name` (String) Plan name whose platform plan ID should be read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by the API.
